bug_semantics: Authenticated CSRF (CWE-352) on Kimai admin 'create default team' shortcuts. GET /admin/{project|customer|activity}/{id}/create_team (locale-prefixed as /en/admin/.../create_team) ran createDefaultTeamAction, which persisted authorization-structure writes: create or later reuse a Team named after the object, add the current user as teamlead, bind the Project/Customer/Activity to that team, and save. A logged-in victim with create_team plus object permissions could be tricked by a malicious page into those writes without a CSRF token, because browsers issue cross-site GETs without a mutating-method/CSRF check.
flaw_origin: On 2020-01-14 Kevin Papst first wrote CustomerController::createDefaultTeamAction in PR #1371 member 8a4e340e as a GET-only @Route /{id}/create_team that constructed a Team, setTeamLead(current user), addCustomer, and saveTeam, then redirected. The same GET-write shortcut was copied to projects later the same day (60b0a3ef) and to activities in #1872 (0914ebf73). The CSRF is the GET mutating design; later refactors (attributes in #2902, reuse/addTeamlead in #3780 / 2.45) did not introduce the GET write, they only restated it.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GHSA-pgcc-vfmc-7cw5 / CVE-2026-49992 is a real CWE-352. Vendor and GitHub advisories agree GET default-team shortcuts created/reused a Team, assigned the victim as teamlead, and bound project/customer/activity, requiring only that the victim already could manage that object's permissions. CVE.org has no record yet and NVD has not published, but GitHub withdrawn_at is null and kimai.org still lists the issue as patched in 2.58.0, so this is not a withdrawn/false advisory. The GET write exists in 2.55.0-2.57.0 and is gone in 2.58.0. BIC search used blame at 2.57.0 as a lead, then decomposed the 2020 squash 6a44dbfe (#1371) via public PR members rather than treating the squash as first-write. The smallest commit that first wrote the GET mutating shortcut is 8a4e340e (customer createDefaultTeamAction); its parent 8c967ace still has only the old budget GET page. Project and activity GET writers are later copies of that mechanism, not independent first writes. AI judged only on that BIC object: human Kevin Papst, no AI co-author/generator/bot marker. Fix judged separately: PR #5952 member fc52180f is the direct GHSA patch; 31a8f887 is the squash that landed on main and is tag 2.58.0. Closed NOT_AI.
